title: Iphutha ngaphandle komongo
description: Le ngxoxo isisondele emkhawulweni wememori ye-AI, njengophahla olugcwele. Singandisa iwindi lememo (elibizwa ngokuthi usayizi wombhalo) ukuze ikhumbule kabanzi, kodwa kungenzeka ukuthi isebenzise imemori eyengeziwe yekhompyutha yakho. Singabuye sinciphise okokufaka, okusho ukuthi izokhohlwa izingxenye zomlando wengxoxo ukuze kwenziwe indawo yemiyalezo emisha.
contextOverflowDetail: Lesi sicelo sidinge amathokheni {{request}}, kodwa iwindi lombhalo lemodeli ligcina kuphela {{context}}.
emptyReply: Imodeli iphelile ngaphandle kokubuyisela impendulo. Zama ukuzenzela kabusha, noma hlola izilungiselelo zomphakeli.

engine.MODEL_ARCH_NOT_SUPPORTED: Uhlaka lwale modeli alusisekelwa yinjineli njengamanje. Ukuvuselela injini kusuka kuZilungiselelo kungangeza ukwesekwa.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_TIMED_OUT: Imodeli ithathe isikhathi eside kakhulu ukulayishwa futhi imi. Imodeli encane noma usayizi wengqikithi omncane ngokuvamile usiza.
engine.MISSING_SHARED_LIBRARY: Ilayibrari injini edinga ilahlekile, ngakho ayikwazi ukuqala.
engine.GPU_DRIVER_TOO_OLD: Umshayeli wakho GPU udala kakhulu kule njineli. Ukuvuselela umshayeli, noma ukushintshela enjini CPU kuZilungiselelo, kuzolungisa lokhu.
engine.OUT_OF_MEMORY: Akukhona okwanele kwememori yokusebenzisa le modeli. Imodeli encane noma usayizi wengqikithi omncane ngokuvamile usiza.
engine.IO_ERROR: Ifayela alikwazanga ukufundwa noma ukubhalwa ngesikhathi kuqalwa imodeli.
engine.INTERNAL_ERROR: Kuthile akwenzeki kahle ngaphakathi Novera ngesikhathi kuqalwa imodeli.
engine.ENGINE_UNREACHABLE: Injini ye-llama.cpp iyasebenza, kodwa Novera ayikwazi ukuyixhuma kule computadora (127.0.0.1). I-VPN, i-proxy noma isofthiwe yezokuphepha kungenzeka ivimbe ukuxhumana okwendawo.
engine.ENGINE_STOPPED: Injini ye-llama.cpp ime ngezizathu ezingalindelekile. Ukuthumela umlayezo futhi kuyiqalisa futhi; uma iqhubeka imisa, isofthiwe yezokuphepha noma i-driver ye-GPU kungenzeka iyimbangela.
engine.UNSUPPORTED_CPU: Izimodeli zendawo azisekelwanga ku-processor yale computadora. Injini yendawo ye-Novera yakhelwe ama-Apple Silicon Macs (M1 noma kamuva), ngakho ayikwazi ukuqala ku-Mac ye-Intel. Abahlinzeki befu nabahlinzeki abakhethekile basasebenza.

serverPortOccupiedDescription: I-Port {{port}} isivele isetshenzisiwe. Sicela uzame enye i-port.
